html_source: Table Bay, 1863, late 17th century oil on canvas painting by Aernout Smit, held in the Castle of Good Hope, Cape Town, showing ships of the Dutch East India Company at a time when the Dutch merchant fleet was by far the largest in Europe. Source: Wikimedia Commons.

search_text.text:
Table Bay, 1863, late 17th century oil on
  canvas painting by Aernout Smit, held in the Castle of Good
  Hope, Cape Town, showing ships of the Dutch East India Company
  at a time when the Dutch merchant fleet was by far the largest
  in Europe. Source: Wikimedia Commons.

title: TableBay
